label: def:local-shadow-ordering
title: Local shadow-price ordering $\preceq_q$
html:
Definition. Local shadow-price ordering \preceq_q

Definition. For two partitions \lambda_1, \lambda_2 with shadow prices y_{\lambda_1}(q), y_{\lambda_2}(q) \in R, the local shadow-price ordering at q is:

  \lambda_1 \;\preceq_q\; \lambda_2
  \;\iff\;
  \exists\, U \ni q\;\text{open such that}\;
  |y_{\lambda_1}(q')| \;\leq\; |y_{\lambda_2}(q')|
  \;\;\forall q' \in U.

We read this as: "\lambda_1 has at most the energy of \lambda_2 on a neighborhood of q".
